components.name: Primary Pine Button
components.description: Primary forward action for signing in, adding a gift, or claiming a gift.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; background: var(--color-pine, #008042); color: #ffffff; font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-pine-hover, #006835); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid #008042; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Pill Button
components.description: Calm secondary actions such as Refresh, Back to Family, Edit, and Undo.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-border-strong, #d8baa0); background: var(--color-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--color-ink, #101010); font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-peach-soft, #fff0e2); border-color: var(--color-ink-muted, #5c4b43); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid #008042; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Cranberry Confirm Button
components.description: Explicit second-tap destructive button for removing an unpicked gift.
components.css: .ds-btn-cranberry { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; background: var(--color-cranberry, #c73213); color: #ffffff; font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-cranberry:hover { background: var(--color-cranberry-hover, #a7270d); } .ds-btn-cranberry:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid #008042; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Wishlist Tab Switcher
components.description: Two-tab pill navigation inside the peach-cream header separating Family and My Wishlist.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tab-bar" aria-label="Wishlist sections"><button class="ds-tab-btn" aria-current="page" type="button">Family</button><button class="ds-tab-btn" type="button">My Wishlist</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tab-bar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; padding: 4px; background: rgba(255, 248, 240, 0.72); border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab-btn { min-height: 48px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: #46332b; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-btn:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55); color: #101010; } .ds-tab-btn[aria-current="page"] { background: #ffffff; color: #101010; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(16, 16, 16, 0.08); } .ds-tab-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid #008042; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Warm-bordered text input for invited email, gift name, and optional store URL.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" value="Wool scarf in forest green" aria-label="Gift name" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 15px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-border-strong, #d8baa0); background: var(--color-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--color-ink, #101010); font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #008042; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 128, 66, 0.16); }

components.description: Paired text label and lock/gift icon marking a claimed gift without revealing the giver.

narrative.overview:
Family Christmas Wishlist treats gift coordination like an inviting, tactile holiday greeting card rather than a spreadsheet or dark novelty widget. Warm cream cardstock (#fff8f0) grounds the entire experience so relatives reading on phones or laptops feel calm clarity, while warm peach-cream headers (#ffdec3) and crisp snow-white gift cards (#ffffff) establish immediate hierarchy.

Every interactive control follows a restraint-first Operate pattern: clear labels paired with unmistakable semantic color cues—pine green (#008042) exclusively for forward gift and picking actions, cranberry red (#c73213) for claimed/locked status and destructive confirmation. No decorative kickers, nested cards, or modal clutter interrupt the single-column flow.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream and peach cardstock palette with deep charcoal (#101010) typography.
Single-column centered layout (34rem max width) built for effortless mobile touch and clean desktop parity.
Self-hosted variable Figtree typography with fixed rem hierarchy and tabular-nums on counts and sign-in codes.
Text status labels paired with visual cues (Already picked, You picked this, Wishlist coming soon) so status is never communicated by color or strike-through alone.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Action Rule
rules.body: Only pine green (#008042) triggers primary gift/navigation commitment and only cranberry (#c73213) signals taken status or destructive confirmation; neutral surfaces handle everything else.

dos: Do keep gift rows in stable creation-time order (created_at, id) even as claim statuses change.
Do pair every color or strike-through cue with explicit status text (Already picked, You picked this, Wishlist coming soon).
Do declare elevation once per card—either ambient shadow or flat tint/border.
donts: Don't add kickers or eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't use single-side border stripes on notices or gift cards.
Don't reveal who picked a gift in My Wishlist or relative list responses.
Don't replace HollyEmblem or lucide-react icons with Unicode emoji or glyph symbols.
